interface.name: kywc_stream_manager_v1

description.summary: managing PipeWire stream for output and toplevel

interface.description: This object is a manager which offers PipeWire stream for output and toplevel.

entry.name: embedded
entry.summary: Render the cursor on the stream

entry.name: metadata
entry.summary: Send metadata about where the cursor is through PipeWire

description.summary: requests a stream from a given source
requests a stream from a given source

request.name: destroy
request.description: All objects created by the manager will still remain valid, until their appropriate destroy request has been called.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: delete this object, used or not

request.description: Destroys the stream. This request can be sent at any time by the client.

event.name: failed
event.description: This event indicates that the attempted stream has failed. After receiving this event, the client should destroy the object.

event.name: cancelled
event.description: Sent if the compositor cancels the stream because the source has gone. Upon receiving this event, the client should destroy this object.

arg.name: node
arg.summary: node id of the pipewire stream
